items.title: Classical adversary bounds lift to randomized communication complexity with a constant-size versatile gadget
items.author: Anurag Anshu; Shalev Ben-David; Srijita Kundu
items.source_version: Official complete39-pageCCC2021 publication,2021-07-08; mainTheorem1 and completeSections2–3 classical lifting author proof. Nativev1 is private transcription aid only.
items.difficulty_reason: The authors use a versatile constant gadget to couple opposite input blocks, break input dependencies with auxiliary random variables, and turn conditional transcript information into a feasible classical adversary weight scheme for the outer relation.
